title: ABOVE-GRADE WALL ASSEMBLIES
previewText:
RF102.1 Wood-framed walls. Wood-framed above-grade wall assemblies shall comply with both the cavity
insulation and continuous insulation R-values and framing conditions specified by Table RF102.1 where
the tabulated U-factors are less than or equal to those needed for compliance with Section R402.1.2. For
